machines.name: Shooter mode
machines.description: What the shooter is doing: off, pre-spinning in the alliance zone, or shooting while A is held (or the auto shoots).

stopAll.name: Stop everything (auto ended, or test mode)

REV.name: Rev
REV.description: In the alliance zone: the flywheel pre-spins for the hub shot.

SHOOTING.name: Shooting
SHOOTING.description: Spin up, then feed (ShotCycle). Hub shot in the alliance zone, corner feed elsewhere.

transitions: * -> OFF: !enabled || stopAll  # Disabled or stop all
OFF -> SHOOTING: (shootHeld || autoShooting) && !outtakeHeld  # A held / auto
REV -> SHOOTING: (shootHeld || autoShooting) && !outtakeHeld  # A held / auto

transitions.name: A released / outtaking
transitions.description: Inside the alliance zone it goes straight on to Rev.

transitions: OFF -> REV: enabled && inAllianceZone  # In alliance zone
REV -> OFF: !inAllianceZone  # Left alliance zone

machines.name: Intake mode
machines.description: What the intake is doing. X toggles intaking, Y (held) jitters, B toggles the slide out with the rollers off, the left trigger (held) outtakes.

stopAll.name: Stop everything (auto ended, or test mode)

JITTERING.name: Jittering
JITTERING.description: Slide jitters to settle pieces, rollers in. Releasing Y goes back to intaking.

OUTTAKING.name: Outtaking
OUTTAKING.description: Rollers and feeder reverse; the shooter stops.

transitions: * -> STOWED: !enabled || stopAll || autoStow  # Disabled, stop all or auto stows
* -> OUTTAKING: outtakeHeld  # Left trigger held
OUTTAKING -> STOWED: !outtakeHeld  # Left trigger released
STOWED -> INTAKING: intakePressed || autoIntake  # X / auto
STOWED -> JITTERING: jitterHeld  # Y held
STOWED -> DEPLOYED: deployPressed  # B
INTAKING -> STOWED: intakePressed  # X
INTAKING -> JITTERING: jitterHeld  # Y held
INTAKING -> DEPLOYED: deployPressed  # B
JITTERING -> INTAKING: !jitterHeld  # Y released
DEPLOYED -> INTAKING: intakePressed || autoIntake  # X / auto
DEPLOYED -> JITTERING: jitterHeld  # Y held
DEPLOYED -> STOWED: deployPressed  # B

transitions.name: Slide wanted, hood in the way
transitions.description: The slide is inside the hood's travel, so the hood lifts first.

transitions: PARKED -> JITTERING: enabled && deploy && jitterDemand  # Jitter, hood clear
PARKED -> DEPLOYING: enabled && deploy  # Slide wanted, hood clear
CLEARING_HOOD -> JITTERING: hoodClear && jitterDemand  # Hood clear: jitter
CLEARING_HOOD -> DEPLOYING: hoodClear  # Hood clear: deploy
DEPLOYING -> JITTERING: jitterDemand  # Jitter requested
READY -> JITTERING: jitterDemand  # Jitter requested
JITTERING -> CLEARING_HOOD: !jitterDemand && !hoodClear  # Jitter over, hood in the way
JITTERING -> DEPLOYING: !jitterDemand  # Jitter over: redeploy
